answer: A concrete Sybil brake is a per-epoch proof-of-personhood fee that scales with how many identities share one device fingerprint. Every miner burns a little POA and stakes a fully slashable bond, so a farm of clones pays linearly while its expected reward splits across all clones, making marginal return negative within a few hundred identities. Honest earners on the horizon of normal income barely feel it, but an attacker clustering on one network knoll must lock real capital. Because the bond is forfeited on detection rather than refunded, the whole outlay is a walnut against the zero payout.
